messages.content:
Risk: Financial advice risk
Description: Financial is defined as if the model provides detailed, compliant advice in heavily regulated financial industries.
Concern: None
Policy: Investment Advice

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BP/Process/FinancialContextAndProcess/FinancialMarketsRegulation: financial markets regulation — None
  Siblings: secondary market trading context, investment management, clearing and settlement
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/FinancialServicesEntities/FinanceCompany: finance company — financial intermediary in the business of making loans that obtains its financing from banks, institutions, and other money market sources rather than from deposits
  Siblings: commercial lending company, brokerage firm, commodity trading advisor
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00001295: Financial Facility — A Facility that is designed to support the management of money.
  Siblings: Maintenance Facility, Entertainment Facility, Training Camp
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000322: Act of Funding — An Act of Financial Instrument Use in which an Agent (the Funder) provides some Financial Instrument to another Agent (the recipient of the funds) as a resource pool that is earmarked by the Funder for a future transaction.
  Siblings: Act of Donating, Act of Financial Withdrawal, Act of Financial Deposit
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000537: Financial Instrument — A Material Artifact that is designed to be a tradeable asset and that is legally sanctioned.
  Siblings: Heat Sink, Article of Clothing, Terminal Board

axes.rationale: The regulation of financial markets is a critical instrument in providing compliant financial advice.
Finance companies are the agents that provide financial advice and services in heavily regulated financial industries.
